senses.gloss: f. ch. (= h. הַבְרָאָה; ברי) mourners’ meal on returning from burial.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 49:4">Gen. R. s. 49</cite> <he>זו ה׳</he> this (<he>צדקה</he> <cite ref="Genesis 18:19">Gen. XVIII, 19</cite>) means the custom of offering mourners the meal &c. Y. M. Kat. III, end, 83ᵈ <he>עבדון ליה איב׳</he> (read <cite ref="E00189"><he>אוֹ׳</he></cite>) they prepared for him &c.
